packs.explanation: This shipment of dried mango slices was flagged because the pickup origin is located inside the La Mesa quarantine zone. While rule R1 exempts dried products, it is currently unknown whether this specific product meets the necessary processing standards for the exemption. We need to confirm the exact drying method and packaging details to resolve this.
checklist: Confirm whether the dried mangoes meet the required drying standards under R1 with USDA APHIS.
Confirm whether a compliance agreement is needed for the facility with CDFA.
Confirm whether the product form qualifies for the exemption with the San Diego County Agricultural Commissioner.
